name: Two-plane light field parameterization with re-parameterization
definition: A light field representation parameterized by two planes π_xy and π_uv with local coordinates (x, y) and (u, v), extended by learning a re-parameterization (local affine transforms) to align the network's interpolation kernels with the object surface π_st.
summary: This method improves view synthesis by learning local affine transforms to align interpolation kernels with the object surface, solving the misalignment issues of standard two-plane parameterization.
